pr_title: Fix Navigation for anchor inside <svg> element
pr_body:
# Fix Navigation for `<svg>` element

## Description

Fixes enhanced navigation inside `<svg>` element. More detailed description see in the issues.

Fixes #51705
Fixes #51440
